The main takeaway from our work is that
the morphologies of galaxies are remarkably consistent with local samples out to z 0.9 and that the morphologies are consistent across different surveys, filters, and depths.
the morphological evolution of galaxies out to z ~ 1 is not a simple process, but is instead complex, with different types of galaxies evolving in different ways, depending on their environment.
